nina_sales: Quick ask — SilverGate Bank (regulated, private deployment) requesting a one-time onboarding credit framed as a 'setup voucher' to cover extra on-prem validation. Deal: 12-mo Dedicated commit (~$430k ARR) + managed support. Sales asks for $16,500 credit applied across first invoice. Approvals?

aisha: Need PS SOW and hours. Is this pure credit or do they want us to reduce PS fees? Also prefer clawback for early churn.

nina_sales: SOW in Deal Desk (link). Estimated eng/SRE hours ~220 (~$28k cost). Customer will pay $11.5k PS; remaining gap = $16.5k voucher.

lucy_cs: CS: we can absorb rotations for onboarding month. Request that voucher be tied to milestone acceptance to avoid disputes.

amy_revops: RevOps checklist: 1) Map voucher to subscription SKU; 2) Create one-time credit ledger entry; 3) Tag GL 4322; 4) Recommend 90-day clawback. Need tax review for voucher treatment.

olivia_legal: Legal: OK with voucher concept. Will draft a short addendum tying voucher to acceptance milestones and 90-day clawback. Need final SOW timeline to complete.

ben_finance: Finance position: can approve up to $12k one-time voucher without CFO review. Anything above $12k needs @tom_cfo. Conditions: RevOps entry, legal addendum with 90-day clawback, CS milestone signoff.

nina_sales: Customer timeline: wants kickoff next Wed. If finance can't approve full amount can we split: $12k voucher + $4.5k PS concession?
aisha: Fine with that split. Approve conditionally: $12,000 one-time voucher applied to first invoice + optional $4,500 reduction in PS fees (booked as PS discount), subject to RevOps ledger entry, Legal addendum, and CS milestone signoff. If Sales insists on voucher >12k escalate to CFO.

lucy_cs: I can confirm milestones and staffing. Will add acceptance criteria to SOW. :white_check_mark:

amy_revops: I'll update Deal Desk and prepare ledger entry. Ping tax team for voucher treatment.

billing-bot: NOTE: provisional kickoff scheduled 2026-04-10 pending executed addendum and ledger entries.
